scope: Analysis of frozen source model, support batches and deployed selector choices; no model/controller refit

cross_query_identity_oracle.definition: Within each episode split unique query IDs in two; use labels to select action on half and score other half, reverse and combine all 32 scoring draws. Repeated identity draws stay together. Ties favor SOURCE.
cross_query_identity_oracle.limits: Label-assisted retrospective diagnostic, not a deployable oracle or estimate of unlimited-data true action risk. Split quantiles measure random partition sensitivity, not independent population uncertainty.

cheap_vs_rich_query_identity_cluster_boo.definition: Resample original query identities, keeping every occurrence of a sampled identity across all final episodes together; recompute weighted cheap-minus-rich error reduction.
cheap_vs_rich_query_identity_cluster_boo.limits: Policies, source fit, support sets and family construction remain fixed. Correlation induced by repeated support IDs and shared fitted models is not removed. This is a more dependence-aware conditional sensitivity analysis, not a full population confidence guarantee.
